title: 檔案路徑穿越：簡單情況
note: 前置：Linux 路徑、HTTP GET、Burp Repeater。需 Academy 帳號，在自己的 Lab instance 練習。

en.title: File path traversal, simple case
en.note: Prerequisites: Linux paths, HTTP GET and Burp Repeater. An Academy account and your own lab instance are required.

title: 沒有權限保護的管理功能
note: 前置：HTTP、登入與授權的差別。只在自己的官方 Lab 執行題目要求的管理操作；需帳號。

en.title: Unprotected admin functionality
en.note: Prerequisites: HTTP and the difference between authentication and authorization. Perform the required admin operation only in your own official lab; account required.

title: SQL 注入：WHERE 查詢顯示隱藏資料
note: 前置：SELECT、WHERE、字串與 URL 參數。需 Academy 帳號；記錄正常與異常回應差別。

en.title: SQL injection vulnerability in WHERE clause allowing retrieval of hidden data
en.note: Prerequisites: SELECT, WHERE, strings and URL parameters. Academy account required; compare normal and modified responses.

title: 反射型 XSS：未編碼的 HTML 內容
note: 前置：HTML 標籤、搜尋 request／response。需 Academy 帳號；辨識輸入的輸出位置。

en.title: Reflected XSS into HTML context with nothing encoded
en.note: Prerequisites: HTML tags and search requests/responses. Academy account required; identify where the input is rendered.

title: 檔案上傳：伺服器錯誤執行上傳程式
note: 前置：表單上傳、PHP 與靜態檔案的差別。需 Academy 帳號；僅操作自己的官方 Lab，完成後寫禁止執行與驗證方案。

en.title: Remote code execution via web shell upload
en.note: Prerequisites: form uploads and the difference between PHP and static files. Account required; use only your own official lab and document validation and non-execution defenses.

title: SSTI：基本伺服器端模板注入
note: 前置：完成 SQLi/XSS，理解模板與資料、ERB 基本語法。需帳號；教師帶領，官方完整目標包含刪除 Lab 指定檔案。

en.title: Basic server-side template injection
en.note: Prerequisites: SQLi/XSS, templates versus data and basic ERB syntax. Account required; teacher-led. The full official objective deletes a specified file inside the lab.

title: SQL 注入：登入繞過
note: 前置：完成 WHERE 隱藏資料題、了解登入表單。需 Academy 帳號；把根因轉成參數化查詢修補。

en.title: SQL injection vulnerability allowing login bypass
en.note: Prerequisites: the hidden-data WHERE lab and login forms. Academy account required; connect the cause to a parameterized-query fix.

title: SQL UNION：判斷查詢欄位數量
note: 前置：完成兩題基本 SQLi，理解 UNION 與 NULL。需 Academy 帳號；按此題→文字欄位→其他表資料順序。

en.title: SQL injection UNION attack, determining the number of columns returned by the query
en.note: Prerequisites: both basic SQLi labs, UNION and NULL. Account required; continue with the text-column lab, then the other-tables lab.

title: SQL UNION：找出可顯示文字的欄位
note: 前置：完成 UNION 欄位數量題、理解數字與文字型別。需 Academy 帳號；觀察回應而非只背輸入。

en.title: SQL injection UNION attack, finding a column containing text
en.note: Prerequisites: the UNION column-count lab and numeric/string types. Account required; explain the response instead of memorizing input.

title: SQL UNION：讀取其他資料表
note: 前置：完成 UNION 欄位數量與文字欄位兩題。需 Academy 帳號；只讀取自己 Lab 的練習資料。

en.title: SQL injection UNION attack, retrieving data from other tables
en.note: Prerequisites: both UNION column-count and text-column labs. Account required; access only the exercise data in your own lab.

title: 由 request 參數控制使用者角色
note: 前置：完成管理功能題，知道 Cookie 與角色。需 Academy 帳號；辨識由客戶端宣稱的權限。

en.title: User role controlled by request parameter
en.note: Prerequisites: the admin-functionality lab, cookies and roles. Account required; identify authorization claims controlled by the client.

title: 由 request 參數控制使用者 ID
note: 前置：登入 session、資源 ID 與使用者關係。需 Academy 帳號；練習伺服器端資源擁有權檢查。

en.title: User ID controlled by request parameter
en.note: Prerequisites: login sessions, resource IDs and ownership. Account required; connect the lab to server-side ownership checks.

title: 路徑穿越：只擋相對路徑仍能被繞過
note: 前置：完成簡單路徑穿越，分清絕對與相對路徑。需 Academy 帳號；對照黑名單與實際路徑限制。

en.title: File path traversal, traversal sequences blocked with absolute path bypass
en.note: Prerequisites: the simple traversal lab and absolute versus relative paths. Account required; compare deny lists with resolved-path restrictions.

title: 儲存型 XSS：未編碼的 HTML 內容
note: 前置：完成反射型 XSS，理解留言的保存與再次顯示。需 Academy 帳號；不使用真實個人資料。

en.title: Stored XSS into HTML context with nothing encoded
en.note: Prerequisites: reflected XSS and how comments are saved and rendered. Account required; avoid using real personal information.

title: DOM XSS：document.write 使用 URL 資料
note: 前置：反射型 XSS、基本 JavaScript、DOM 與 location.search。需 Academy 帳號；追蹤 source 到 sink。

en.title: DOM XSS in document.write sink using source location.search
en.note: Prerequisites: reflected XSS, basic JavaScript, the DOM and location.search. Account required; trace the source to the sink.

title: OS 命令注入：簡單情況
note: 前置：Linux CLI、shell 與程式參數的差別。需 Academy 帳號；對照直接呼叫函式與拼接 shell 字串。

en.title: OS command injection, simple case
en.note: Prerequisites: Linux CLI and the difference between shells and program arguments. Account required; compare direct APIs with concatenated shell strings.

title: SSRF：存取 Lab 伺服器內部服務
note: 前置：HTTP URL、localhost、伺服器發出的 request。需 Academy 帳號；只操作官方 Lab 指定的內部服務。

en.title: Basic SSRF against the local server
en.note: Prerequisites: HTTP URLs, localhost and server-originated requests. Account required; use only the internal service specified in your official lab.

title: SSRF：另一個 Lab 後端服務
note: 前置：完成 localhost SSRF、IP/port、Burp 操作。需帳號；搜尋範圍只限官方題目指定網段，Community Intruder 可能較慢。

en.title: Basic SSRF against another back-end system
en.note: Prerequisites: localhost SSRF, IP/port and Burp. Account required; limit discovery to the range specified by the lab. Community Intruder may be slower.

title: SSTI：模板程式碼上下文
note: 前置：完成基本 SSTI、Python/Tornado 模板閱讀能力。需帳號；選修且由教師帶領，完整目標包含刪除 Lab 指定檔案。

en.title: Basic server-side template injection (code context)
en.note: Prerequisites: basic SSTI and reading Python/Tornado templates. Account required; teacher-led elective. The full objective deletes a specified lab file.

title: CSRF：沒有防禦的跨站操作
note: 前置：HTML form、Cookie、session 與網站來源。需帳號；只用自己官方 Lab 的帳號和 exploit server。

en.title: CSRF vulnerability with no defenses
en.note: Prerequisites: HTML forms, cookies, sessions and origins. Account required; use only the account and exploit server in your official lab.

title: Your First Program：暫存器與第一個程式
note: 課程模組入口，含 Your First Register 等練習。前置：Linux CLI；登入帳號與接受平台規則後在內建環境開始。

en.title: Your First Program
en.note: Module with exercises such as Your First Register. Prerequisite: Linux CLI. Sign in, accept the platform rules and start in its provided environment.

title: Computer Memory：地址與指標
note: 課程模組入口。前置：Your First Program；先做 Loading From Memory、Dereferencing Pointers。需帳號與內建環境。

en.title: Computer Memory
en.note: Module entry. Prerequisite: Your First Program. Start with Loading From Memory and Dereferencing Pointers; account and provided environment required.

title: The Stack：棧的讀寫與操作
note: 課程模組入口。前置：暫存器與記憶體讀寫；做棧值操作並畫出變化，之後才進入棧溢位。需帳號。

en.title: The Stack
en.note: Module entry. Prerequisites: registers and memory access. Practice stack operations and draw the changes before attempting overflows. Account required.

title: Software Introspection：觀察程式
note: 課程模組入口。前置：地址、指標、棧；學習在 GDB 檢視執行狀態與記憶體。需帳號。

en.title: Software Introspection
en.note: Module entry. Prerequisites: addresses, pointers and the stack. Learn to inspect program execution and memory in GDB; account required.

title: Endian Escapades：位元組次序
note: 課程模組入口。前置：十六進制、位元組、基本組合語言；釐清數值與記憶體排列。需帳號。

en.title: Endian Escapades
en.note: Module entry. Prerequisites: hexadecimal, bytes and basic assembly. Understand numeric values versus their memory layout; account required.

title: Debugging Refresher：除錯複習
note: 課程模組入口。前置：Software Introspection 與程式控制流程；用 breakpoint 和單步觀察檢驗推測。需帳號。

en.title: Debugging Refresher
en.note: Module entry. Prerequisites: Software Introspection and program control flow. Test hypotheses using breakpoints and stepping; account required.

title: Binary Exploitation：第一個棧溢位
note: 課程入口，先選 Your First Overflow (easy)、Precision (easy)、Variable Control (easy)。前置：C 陣列、棧、GDB、位元組。需帳號；後段不是初學門檻。

en.title: Binary Exploitation: first stack overflows
en.note: Start with Your First Overflow (easy), Precision (easy) and Variable Control (easy). Prerequisites: C arrays, stack, GDB and bytes. Account required; later exercises are electives.

title: Program Security：記憶體錯誤課程
note: 進階課程入口，下滑到 Memory Corruption。前置：基礎棧溢位、整數型別、PIE/canary；即使題名含 Easy 也不列中學生入門門檻。需帳號。

en.title: Program Security: Memory Corruption
en.note: Advanced module; go to Memory Corruption. Prerequisites: basic overflows, integer types and PIE/canaries. Even tasks named Easy are not beginner requirements. Account required.

title: ret2win：返回到指定函式
note: 具體可下載題目，無帳號要求。前置：棧溢位、GDB、函式返回；在 Linux 練習 VM 選 x86_64 版本。先讀官方 Beginners' guide。

en.title: ret2win
en.note: A downloadable challenge with no account requirement. Prerequisites: stack overflow, GDB and function returns. Use x86_64 in a Linux practice VM; read the official beginners' guide first.

title: split：第一條短 ROP chain
note: 具體可下載選修題，無帳號要求。前置：完成 ret2win、理解呼叫約定與 NX；適合進一步學習，不列初學通過門檻。

en.title: split
en.note: Downloadable elective with no account requirement. Prerequisites: ret2win, calling conventions and NX. An extension activity, not a beginner pass requirement.

title: CTF Wiki：格式化字串練習例子
note: 教材與例子入口，並非托管的互動靶場。前置：C printf、位元組、GDB；由教師準備本地題目。先學固定 format，GOT/任意寫入留作選修。

en.title: CTF Wiki: format string examples
en.note: A reference with examples, not a hosted interactive lab. Prerequisites: C printf, bytes and GDB; teacher prepares local exercises. Start with fixed formats; GOT/arbitrary writes are electives.

title: picoCTF／CyLab：官方題庫入口
note: 官方登入題庫入口，須帳號；不是某一個題目。搜尋 buffer overflow 0/1、format string 0/1 作候選，教師核對當前在庫與難度；未猜題目深層 URL。

en.title: picoCTF / CyLab: official challenge library
en.note: Official library entry; account required, not a single challenge. Search buffer overflow 0/1 and format string 0/1 as candidates; teachers verify availability and difficulty. No guessed deep links.
